title: Doozy Vape Co Doozy Legends Fizzy lemon 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape’s Fizzy Lemon perfectly captures those beloved sweetshop favourites, Lemon Sherbets, in vape form. Mouth-watering hard lemon candy melts away to a frisky fizz from punchy sherbet, creating a super-sweet and utterly moreish candy vape you’ll want to return to again and again. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks .
